Chart skill test fixture

Loads amvcp-designmd.js then amvcp-chart.js as browser globals. window.__vcManualInit is set so the test drives injectChartCSS + scan deterministically. Each fenced chart:<type>@1 block is replaced by a rendered <figure.ve-chart>.

Bar — single series, sorted descending

{
  "title": "Revenue by quarter",
  "series": [{ "label": "2025", "data": [
    {"x":"Q1","y":2.4},{"x":"Q2","y":3.1},
    {"x":"Q3","y":2.8},{"x":"Q4","y":3.6}
  ] }],
  "options": { "sortDescending": true, "valueLabels": true }
}

Stacked bar — multi-series

{
  "title": "Headcount by team",
  "series": [
    { "label": "Eng", "data": [
      {"x":"Q1","y":12},{"x":"Q2","y":15},{"x":"Q3","y":18}] },
    { "label": "Design", "data": [
      {"x":"Q1","y":4},{"x":"Q2","y":5},{"x":"Q3","y":6}] }
  ]
}

Diverging bar — signed values

{
  "title": "Net sentiment by region",
  "series": [{ "label": "score", "data": [
    {"x":"NA","y":34},{"x":"EU","y":-12},
    {"x":"APAC","y":21},{"x":"LATAM","y":-8}
  ] }]
}

  ]

Waterfall — cumulative bridge

{
  "title": "Q4 profit bridge ($M)",

    {"x":"Start","delta":12},
    {"x":"Sales","delta":8},
    {"x":"Costs","delta":-5},
    {"x":"Tax","delta":-3},
    {"x":"End","isTotal":true}
  ] }]
}

Heatmap — value grid with OKLCH ramp

{
  "title": "Errors by hour and weekday",
  "series": [{ "label": "errors", "data": [] }],
  "options": {
    "grid": [
      [2, 5, 9, 14, 6],
      [3, 8, 22, 31, 9],
      [1, 4, 7, 12, 5],
      [0, 2, 6, 18, 40]
    ],
    "rowLabels": ["Night","Morning","Noon","Evening"],
    "colLabels": ["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri"]
  }
}

Metric cards — KPI row

Pie — guardrail (must remap to a sorted bar)

{
  "title": "Budget split",
  "series": [{ "label": "budget", "data": [
    {"x":"R&D","y":40},{"x":"Sales","y":35},
    {"x":"Ops","y":25}
  ] }]
}

Canvas threshold — >100 marks switch to a canvas backend

{
  "title": "Large dataset (120 bars)",
  "series": [{ "label": "v", "data": [] }]
}

Error — missing required title (must fail loud)

{
  "series": [{ "label": "x", "data": [{"x":"A","y":1}] }]
}

Error — malformed JSON (must degrade, keep the text)

{
  "title": "Broken",
  "series": [{ "label": "x", "data": [{"x":"A","y":1},] }
}

Error — unknown chart type

{
  "title": "Not a real type",
  "series": [{ "label": "x", "data": [{"x":"A","y":1}] }]
}

Error — version newer than the runtime supports

{
  "title": "From the future",
  "series": [{ "label": "x", "data": [{"x":"A","y":1}] }]
}
